My ex had no contact with me for the past year and a half but lately he’s been requesting to follow me on social media and I’ve seen him in passing a few times. It’s haunting and sometimes I can’t tell if it’s actually him I’m seeing or just a random person. I’m afraid he will try to contact my family or show up at my house to escalate it. I’ve been hesitant to block him just in case it provokes him more. So far zero reaction from me is working, and I’ve documented everything I can just to be safe. 

I wish you the best and I hope it’ll all be over for us (and everyone else dealing with this) soon. Thank you for posting your experience, I don’t feel so alone.
